transcript: Speaker A: PCL Season 1 ke winners. How does it feel? [PCL Season 1 winners. How does it feel?] Speaker B: I feel absolutely nice. Feeling great. Speaker A: Almost ek saal complete... [Almost one year complete...] Speaker C: Chalti-kirti English nikal rahi hai. Absolutely nice. [Fluent English is coming out. Absolutely nice.] Speaker A: She is like, ab toh main winner hoon, ab toh main sirf English mein baat karti hoon. Download the PW Talk app today and start practicing from today.]
